items.title: 4.1 Concept of mole (mole ka matlab) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and topic 4.1, printed pages 74-76, with the sample problems worked and Quick Check 4.1 answered.

blocks.text: Lafz stoichiometry do Greek words se bana hai: stoicheion yani element, aur metron yani naap (measure). Is tarah stoichiometry ka matlab hai reactants aur products ki quantity (miqdar) ko naapna.

blocks.title: Stoichiometry
blocks.text: Stoichiometry (bolte hain: stoy-key-om-eh-tree) chemistry ki woh branch hai jis mein balanced chemical equation ke reactants aur products ki amounts (miqdar) ka aapas mein relationship (talluq) parha jata hai.

Balanced chemical equation mein har qism ke atoms dono taraf barabar hote hain. Is mein reactants aur products ek fixed ratio (tanasub) mein hote hain, bilkul jaise compound mein elements fixed ratio mein hote hain. Inhi ratios se doosre substances ka mass ya moles nikala jata hai.

Stoichiometry ke hisab do laws (qanoon) maante hain: law of conservation of mass aur law of definite proportions. Law of conservation of mass kehta hai ke “matter (mass) na banaya ja sakta hai na khatam kiya ja sakta hai”. Stoichiometry mein is ka matlab hai ke balanced equation mein reactants ka kul mass products ke kul mass ke barabar hota hai. Law of definite proportions kehta hai ke ek pure (khalis) compound mein elements hamesha mass ke ek hi ratio mein mile hote hain.

blocks.title: Mole
blocks.text: Mole kisi substance ki woh amount (miqdar) hai jis mein utni hi elementary entities (sab se chhote particles) hon jitne 0.012 kg (12 g) carbon-12 mein atoms hote hain.

Yeh entities atoms, molecules, ions, electrons ya doosre particles ho sakte hain. Mole ko n se likhte hain. Ek mole mein entities ki tadaad ek fixed number hai jise Avogadro’s number kehte hain: 6.02 x 10²³. Ise Nₐ se likhte hain. Yeh value Italian scientist Amedeo Avogadro (1776-1856) ke naam se hai.

blocks.title: Did you Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Avogadro’s number ek physical constant hai jo ek mole mein particles ki tadaad batata hai. Is ki exact (poori) value 6.02214076 x 10²³ mol⁻¹ hai (2019 se muqarrar). Hisab mein hum round off value 6.02 x 10²³ istemal karte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki value 6.02214179 × 10²³ exact nahi; yeh purani napi hui value hai. 2019 se Avogadro constant bilkul 6.02214076 × 10²³ mol⁻¹ muqarrar (fixed) hai; hisab mein 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹ lete hain.

items: ¹²C ke 1 mole mein ¹²C ke 6.02 x 10²³ atoms hote hain.
H₂O ke 1 mole mein H₂O ke 6.02 x 10²³ molecules hote hain.
NaCl ke 1 mole mein NaCl ke 6.02 x 10²³ formula units hote hain.
Na⁺ ke 1 mole mein Na⁺ ke 6.02 x 10²³ ions hote hain.

blocks.text: Chemists atoms, molecules, formula units ya ions ko tolne aur ginne ke liye mole ko SI unit ke taur par istemal karte hain.

Kisi substance (element, compound ya ionic species) ke ek mole ka mass us ke atomic mass, molecular mass, formula mass ya ionic mass ke barabar hota hai jab use grams mein likha jaye. Ise molar mass kehte hain aur M se likhte hain.

blocks.title: Molar mass
blocks.text: Kisi substance ke ek mole ka mass, grams mein, us ka molar mass kehlata hai.
Molar mass ka unit g/mol hai. Molar mass us substance ke sab atoms ke masses ka jor (sum) hota hai.
CCl₄ ke ek mole ka mass nikalne ke liye carbon aur chlorine ke masses jama karte hain:

blocks.latex: \begin{aligned}\text{Molar mass of }\ce{CCl4} &= \text{Molar mass of one C} + \text{Molar mass of Cl} \times 4\\ &= 12.0 \times 1 + 35.5 \times 4\\ \text{Molar mass of }\ce{CCl4} &= 12.0 + 142.0 = 154.0\ \text{g}\end{aligned}
blocks.text_alt: Molar mass of CCl₄ = Molar mass of one C + Molar mass of Cl x 4 = 12.0 x 1 + 35.5 x 4; Molar mass of CCl₄ = 12.0 + 142.0 = 154.0 g
